section.title: Mailing Services FAQ
section.description: Answers to common questions about EDDM, presort, Postalocity automation, and concierge mailing support from Broadstroke, Inc. in Wichita, KS.

faqs.q: What is the difference between EDDM and traditional presort mailing?
faqs.a: Every Door Direct Mail (EDDM) targets entire carrier routes without needing a mailing list or permit, making it ideal for local saturation at the lowest postage rates. Presort services use your targeted list and sort mail to qualify for discounted rates on First-Class or Marketing Mail. Broadstroke handles both with concierge service, including list management and address verification.

faqs.q: How does Postalocity reduce manual work for statements and invoices?
faqs.a: Postalocity automates the entire workflow — from secure data upload to printing, folding, inserting, sealing, and USPS submission. High-speed commercial equipment ensures 100% accuracy while meeting USPS formatting standards. Clients reclaim hours weekly by eliminating manual preparation steps and gain real-time tracking without managing a physical mailroom.

faqs.q: What makes your address verification process more effective than standard services?
faqs.a: We verify address history through the National Change of Address program for four full years instead of the typical 18 months. Combined with CASS certification, this deeper check reduces returned mail and improves delivery rates for utility bills, government notices, and marketing campaigns.

faqs.q: Do you support mailing for government and municipal clients?
faqs.a: Yes. Broadstroke, Inc. is a trusted partner for cities, counties, parishes, and utilities nationwide. We handle Change of Value Notices, Agricultural Use Surveys, tax mailings, utility bills, and certified mail with secure, compliant processes and concierge oversight.

faqs.q: Can I integrate mailing services with printing and promotional products?
faqs.a: Absolutely. As a full-service provider, we manage end-to-end projects — design, printing, mailing, fulfillment, and promotional items — with one point of contact. This one-stop concierge model eliminates coordination across multiple vendors.

faqs.q: How does Broadstroke ensure accuracy for high-volume mailings?
faqs.a: Every piece routes through our commercial printers and inserters with built-in 100% accuracy verification. Lists receive expert change-of-address processing, and all mail meets USPS standards before prompt submission. Our 45+ year history supports consistent results for businesses and institutions.

faqs.q: What is included in fulfillment and distribution services?
faqs.a: We produce, pack, and ship printed materials, apparel, giveaways, or other items you provide. Whether for direct mail campaigns or broader distribution, our team handles the logistics so you receive professional results without managing warehousing or shipping details.

faqs.q: How do I get started with a free estimate for mailing services?
faqs.a: Contact our team at 316-262-3333 or orders@broadstrokeinc.com. Provide details about your project — list size, format, or automation needs — and we will deliver a customized estimate focused on efficiency, accuracy, and convenience. Use promo code mail2026 for Postalocity platform signup at https://prod.postalocity.com/login.html?signUp=true&promo=mail2026.
